main.description: Declares a video feed generator and the ranking approach it uses, so clients can present user-selectable feeds with their method disclosed. The record can exist in any repository; its AT-URI is the feed URI passed to getFeedSkeleton.

did.description: DID of the service that serves this feed.

rankingCriteria.description: Self-declared family of ranking method. 'chronological' and 'heuristic' use no individual data; 'social' uses the public follow graph; 'personalized' and 'collaborative' require opted-in engagement data; 'hybrid' combines families.
